svg.title: Factors 10 and 11. Thin adapters turn Slack, web chat and email messages into the same structured input (factor 11). A small router, which can run on a cheap model, knows who handles what but not how. It sends each request to a specialist: a refund agent with the refund policy and 3 tools, a shipping agent, or an exchange agent (factor 10). The alternative is one agent with a 3,000-token prompt and 15 or more tools, which gets less predictable with every feature.

text.font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Thin adapters in, a small router, focused agents
